result.description:
Welder – Griffith NSW

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-standing regional farming business operating in large-scale cotton production based in regional New South Wales. The operation is focused on efficient, high-quality harvest outcomes supported by modern machinery and practical, experienced farm teams.

Our client manages a large-scale fleet of heavy machinery, earthmoving equipment, and specialized agricultural implements. To maximize fleet uptime and keep our operations running smoothly across the region, we are seeking an experienced, self-motivated Full-Time Welder to join the team.

As the new welder, will be responsible for the structural maintenance, repair, modification, and fabrication of our entire fleet. This role requires a skilled trade professional who understands the unique stresses placed on heavy earthmoving and broadacre farming equipment and can deliver high-quality, high-strength welds that stand up to harsh operating conditions.

Responsibilities

    Welding and construction responsibilities for agriculture equipment

    Preparation of various metal types (mild steel, bisalloy, stainless steel and cast) for cutting  (oxy/acetylene torch, grinders and drop saws), joining (mig welding and manual arc)  and hard facing(tungsten and 412 floppy rod)

    Constructing frames for row crop tillage and repairing various machines  which are worn or in need of repair

    Hard facing numerous points on cultivators, rippers and chisel plows

    Studying drawings, plans and specifications to determine job requirements

    Constructing metal frames for automated water stops out of stainless steel to add  longevity 

   Cutting to the required measurements and detailed application to ensure minimal  losses in the steel

    Welding in different methods single line, triple line, vertical sweep and down run

    Examining welds to ensure strength and precision

    Installing frames for automated stops

    Cleaning and smoothing welds by filing, chiselling and grinding

    Maintain a clean, organized, and safe welding bay and service vehicle.

    Adhere strictly to Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) standards, including  hot-work permits, risk assessments, and proper PPE utilization
    (especially when working around fuels and agricultural chemicals).

To be considered you should

    Possess a Certificate IV in a relevant field of study, or an agreed equivalent.

    Have one or more years of trade or professional experience working in similar roles.

    Demonstrate strong attention to detail, a high standard of work, and proven experience in the welding field.

    Be able to skilfully read and interpret blueprints and fabrication drawings.

    Work with a high level of safety awareness at all times.

    Be capable of undertaking physical labour, including the safe use of workshop equipment

    Be experienced in MIG and other welding techniques.

    Show a proven ability to prioritise, set goals, and maintain the determination to achieve them.

    Enjoy working within cohesive teams and following instructions closely.

    Be highly safety-conscious and comfortable always utilizing required PPE.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only  respond to shortlisted applicants.

As a Barista, you'll brew, prepare, and serve a variety of beverages while providing outstanding customer service in a fast-paced and energetic environment.

•	Expertly prepare and serve a variety of coffee beverages, including espresso, cappuccino, latte, and specialty drinks.

Customer Service:

Maintaining Cleanliness:

Stock Management:

Team Collaboration:

•	Communicate effectively with colleagues and contribute to a positive work environment.

•	At least 1 year of relevant work experience.

• Demonstrated experience in preparing espresso-based coffee, specialty beverages, and other café drinks to a consistently high standard

• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced hospitality environment while maintaining attention to detail

result.description: Munchkin Manor Early Learning Centre  About Munchkin Manor  Munchkin Manor ELC & Pre-school (St George CCC) is a family-owned early learning centre dedicated to providing high-quality education and care in a warm, nurturing and inclusive environment. We believe every child is unique and deserves opportunities to learn, grow and thrive through meaningful play-based experiences. Our team work collaboratively with families to create a safe and engaging environment that promotes children's confidence, independence and lifelong love of learning.  About the Role  We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Early Childhood Teacher and Educational Leader to join our professional team on a full-time basis.  Working closely with the Centre Director and educational team, you will guide and support educators in delivering high-quality educational programs that support children's learning and development in accordance with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF), National Quality Framework (NQF) and National Quality Standard (NQS).  This is an excellent opportunity to work off the floor as well as alongside educators, supporting pedagogical practice and team development.  Key Responsibilities  • Plan, develop, and implement play-based educational programs that support children's cognitive, social, emotional, and physical development in accordance with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF) and contemporary early childhood teaching practices.  • Observe, assess, and document children's learning, development, and behaviour to evaluate progress and inform curriculum planning, individual learning strategies, and continuous improvement of educational programs.  • Create and maintain a safe, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment that supports children's wellbeing, independence, curiosity, and active participation in learning experiences.  • Build positive, respectful, and trusting relationships with children, fostering a sense of belonging and supporting their individual needs in a calm, nurturing, and developmentally appropriate manner.  • Establish and maintain collaborative partnerships with families to support children's learning and development through effective communication, information sharing, and family engagement.  • Promote and uphold a strong child-safe culture by implementing child protection policies and maintaining safe supervision practices that ensure the health, safety, and wellbeing of all children.  • Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals to support inclusive education practices and contribute to a positive, professional team environment.  • Contribute to curriculum planning, program evaluation, and continuous quality improvement processes to enhance the effectiveness of educational programs and service delivery.  • Lead and mentor educators in programming, documentation, and critical reflection, supporting professional practice, teamwork, and the implementation of high-quality early childhood education programs.     About You  To be successful in this role you will have:  · Relevant qualification and at least 1 – 2 years of full-time work experience.  · Current Working with Children Check (NSW).  · Current First Aid, CPR, Asthma and Anaphylaxis qualifications (or willingness to obtain).  · Sound knowledge of the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF), National Quality Standard (NQS) and Education and Care Services National Law and Regulations.  · Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills.  · A genuine passion for supporting children's learning, development and wellbeing.  · Previous experience working in a long day care or preschool setting will be highly regarded.  Why Join Munchkin Manor?  · Join a supportive, family-owned early learning centre with a welcoming team culture.  · Work in a collaborative environment that values quality education and continuous improvement.  · Access ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.  · Receive an attractive remuneration package and stable full-time permanent employment.  · Make a meaningful contribution to children's learning and development within a centre that values strong partnerships with families and the local community.  If you are passionate about early childhood education and are committed to providing high-quality learning experiences for young children where childrens rights and interests are of paramount consideration, we encourage you to submit your application, including your resume and cover letter.
